slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The essay's country table, an AI-assisted compilation by its author, states that rural primary schools in Ghana predominantly record attendance and learning outcomes on paper in manual registers, that daily attendance remains paper-based, and that there is no routine digital entry at the school in most rural schools; it gives no date, so the publication date is used.

systems.tiers: annual census questionnaires completed on paper by head teachers, forwarded to district and regional offices for data entry and aggregation
annual census data entry, promoted for teachers
pilot, 2014, 20 districts; the document does not say what it records
weekly attendance uploads, described as an isolated donor and government initiative; the document does not say whether the upload is per learner or a total
